allow: PowerShell(Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.StartTime -gt \(Get-Date\).AddHours\(-2\)} | Sort-Object CPU -Descending | Select-Object -First 5 Id, StartTime, @{N='CPU_min';E={[math]::Round\($_.CPU/60,1\)}}, @{N='MB';E={[math]::Round\($_.WorkingSet/1MB,0\)}} | Format-Table)

PowerShell(Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.StartTime -gt \(Get-Date\).AddHours\(-8\)} | Sort-Object CPU -Descending | Select-Object -First 5 Id, StartTime, @{N='CPU_min';E={[math]::Round\($_.CPU/60,1\)}}, @{N='MB';E={[math]::Round\($_.WorkingSet/1MB,0\)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize)
